champion: Hereditary Leiomyomatosis and Renal Cell Cancer (HLRCC)
ordered_diagnoses: Hereditary Leiomyomatosis and Renal Cell Cancer (HLRCC)
Succinate Dehydrogenase-Deficient Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (SDH-Deficient GIST)

facts.raw_span: A 29-year-old female presented with a large pelvic mass
soft to firm, large bosselated mass with restricted mobility arising from the pelvis and reaching up to the epigastrium
primary infertility
mass was extending from the right adnexa to the left
bilateral breast nodules suggestive of fibroadenomas on imaging
Cervix not visualized, large firm mass extending into pouch of Douglas
Uterus not felt separately from the mass
Serum tumor markers (CA 125, CA 19.9, CEA, AFP, Inhibin and LDH) were within normal limits
Findings were suggestive of an ovarian primary
Spindle cell tumor composed of elongated cells arranged in long sweeping to poorly formed fascicles
Diffuse hemangiopericytomatous pattern of vasculature
Next generation sequencing (NGS) detected a pathogenic variant in the FH gene (FHc.999C > A p.Cys333Ter)
